title: Testosterone and fathers’ parenting unraveled: Links with the quantity and quality of father-child interactions
descriptions: In this study we examined the links between fathers’ salivary testosterone levels using multiple measures, the amount of time spent with their child (12 to 30 months of age), type of interaction between father and child, and fathers’ sensitivity.
